0.7.1: Resolve: a project with no client goes into a folder named after its space (e.g. Personal), never loose at the top
Mac: Open at login now shows as Nest under Login Items, and Nest offers to move itself to Applications if you opened it from the download
Mac: folder access is explained, and no permission box pops up while Nest is hidden at login
Easier to read and to use with the keyboard: clearer grey text and buttons, Enter does what the focused button says, dialogs keep the cursor inside
Smaller fixes: the preview's fold button opens again, no "control Finder" request, a calmer sidebar, quiet updates on Windows
0.7.0: Nest lives in the menu bar (Windows: by the clock): close the window and it keeps running, with New Project and your recent jobs one click away
DaVinci Resolve: give a template a Resolve starter project, and each new job gets its own copy in Resolve, named and filed for you
New to Nest? A short guide and a "Try an example" button show what happens before you make anything
Templates: drop a template file to add it, the same place you drop a job folder
The Mac app is now signed and checked by Apple, so it opens without a warning
0.6.1: New Project: a yes/no that only adds a folder now reads "Also make: PRINT folder"
Template editor: drag the questions to change their order, and Edit → Undo works on Mac
Marking a project done from your other computer now waits and retries when a file is busy
If Nest can't start, it now says why instead of closing
A quieter update bar, and lots of small safety fixes
0.6.0: Setup is now two steps: where your jobs go, and the folder you copy for every job
Templates: drop a job folder to make a template, click one to change it
A calmer template editor: names show as a real project, with one-click fill-ins
New Project is shorter: the client's files and where it goes, one line each
Nest's own templates no longer add a notes file: add your own files, or Project info
0.5.0: Templates have their own place in the sidebar
A new template editor: your folders as a tree, add a folder anywhere, answers from New Project right in the names
Make a template from one of your project folders
Client kits: a client's brand files come along into new projects (Settings → Client kits)
Keep your templates the same on all your computers (Settings → Devices)
0.4.4: A button to hide the sidebar, also Ctrl/Cmd+B
Sidebar sections can be folded away
